newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - ends with 3/8 point losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - ends with 3/8 point losses.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices ended Tuesday's session down about 3/8 point overall, after comments by a senior Fed official reignited fears of rising interest rates.
"A tranquil market was spoiled by a report this morning that some of the regional Fed bankers are putting pressure on the board of governors to tighten," one muni trader said.
"The market did a 180 degree about-face from (expectations of) a tightening to not tightening last week to tightening again this week," the trader said.
The Federal Reserve official, in an interview with Reuters, said Tuesday that a consensus was emerging around a 25-basis point rise in the Fed funds rate at the upcoming Sept 24 meeting.
Treasuries fell after the comments were reported, and munis followed. The long bond was down 28/32 to 96-20/32 heading into the New York close, with the yield rising to 7.02 percent.
In the muni secondary, yields rose three basis points on Texas Turnpike Authority FGIC 5-1/4s of 2023 to 5.78 percent.
Yields on Intermountain Power Agency, Utah, 5.0s of 2021 jumped nine basis points to 5.90 percent, after showing a four basis point rise at midday.

Several of the days largest new issues were repriced, including The Metropolitan Pier and Exposition Authority, Ill.'s $505 million refunding deal. Smith Barney Inc adjusted yields in several maturities, but left the top yield on the current interest bonds unchanged at 5.90 in 2027.

PaineWebber Inc repriced New York State Thruway Authority's $277.8 million deal, lowering yields in several maturities and cutting the top yield in 2016 to approximately 6.081 percent from 6.10 percent.
Wednesday's new issue calendar features 10 competitive issues totaling $451 million. The largest is a $200 million Massachusetts general obligation deal at 1000 EDT.
The negotiated calendar comprises 10 deals totaling $412 million, topped by a $150 million Illinois Tollway Authority issue via PaineWebber.
